Funkcje do oceny skuteczności¶

In [23]:
def calculate_metrics(y_true, y_pred):
    tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred).ravel()
    sensitivity = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0
    specificity = tn / (tn + fp) if (tn + fp) > 0 else 0
    accuracy = (tp + tn) / (tp + tn + fp + fn)
    return accuracy, sensitivity, specificity

def plot_roc_curve(y_true, y_scores):
    fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_true, y_scores)
    roc_auc = auc(fpr, tpr)
    
    plt.figure(figsize=(6, 6))
    plt.plot(fpr, tpr, color='blue', label=f'ROC Curve (AUC = {roc_auc:.2f})')
    plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], color='red', linestyle='--', label='Losowa klasyfikacja')
    plt.xlabel('False Positive Rate (1 - Specificity)')
    plt.ylabel('True Positive Rate (Sensitivity)')
    plt.title('Krzywa ROC')
    plt.legend(loc='lower right')
    plt.grid()
    plt.show()

def plot_confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred, labels=None):
    cm = confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred)
    plt.figure(figsize=(6, 6))
    disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix=cm, display_labels=labels)
    disp.plot(cmap="Blues", values_format="d")
    plt.title("Macierz Pomyłek")
    plt.show()

def plot_decision_boundary(model, X, y, title="Decision Boundary"):
    x_min, x_max = X[:, 0].min() - 1, X[:, 0].max() + 1
    y_min, y_max = X[:, 1].min() - 1, X[:, 1].max() + 1
    xx, yy = np.meshgrid(np.arange(x_min, x_max, 0.01),
                             np.arange(y_min, y_max, 0.01))
        
    Z = model.predict(np.c_[xx.ravel(), yy.ravel()])
    Z = Z.reshape(xx.shape)
        
    plt.figure(figsize=(6, 6))
    plt.contourf(xx, yy, Z, alpha=0.8, cmap='viridis')
    plt.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=y, edgecolor='k', cmap='viridis', s=50)
    plt.title(title)
    plt.xlabel("Feature 1")
    plt.ylabel("Feature 2")
    plt.grid(True)
    plt.show()

Własna implementacja¶

Drzewo decyzyjne

In [28]:
class DecisionTree:
    class TreeNode:
        def __init__(self, feature=None, threshold=None, left=None, right=None, value=None):
            self.feature = feature
            self.threshold = threshold
            self.left = left
            self.right = right
            self.value = value

    def __init__(self, max_depth=None, max_features=None):
        self.max_depth = max_depth
        self.max_features = max_features 
        self.root = None

    def _gini(self, y):
        probs = np.bincount(y) / len(y)
        return 1 - np.sum(probs ** 2)

    def fit(self, X, y):
        def build(X, y, depth):
            if len(set(y)) == 1 or len(y) == 0 or (self.max_depth and depth >= self.max_depth):
                majority = Counter(y).most_common(1)[0][0]
                return self.TreeNode(value=majority)

            features = np.random.choice(X.shape[1], self.max_features, replace=False)
            best_gain = -1
            best_feature = None
            best_threshold = None

            for i in features:
                values = X[:, i]
                thresholds = np.unique(np.percentile(values, np.arange(10, 100, 10)))
                for t in thresholds:
                    left = y[values <= t]
                    right = y[values > t]
                    if len(left) == 0 or len(right) == 0:
                        continue
                    gini_split = (len(left)/len(y))*self._gini(left) + (len(right)/len(y))*self._gini(right)
                    gain = self._gini(y) - gini_split
                    if gain > best_gain:
                        best_gain = gain
                        best_feature = i
                        best_threshold = t

            if best_feature is None:
                return self.TreeNode(value=Counter(y).most_common(1)[0][0])

            left_mask = X[:, best_feature] <= best_threshold
            left = build(X[left_mask], y[left_mask], depth + 1)
            right = build(X[~left_mask], y[~left_mask], depth + 1)
            return self.TreeNode(best_feature, best_threshold, left, right)

        self.root = build(X, y, 0)

    def predict(self, X):
        def traverse(x, node):
            while node.value is None:
                node = node.left if x[node.feature] <= node.threshold else node.right
            return node.value

        return np.array([traverse(row, self.root) for row in X])

In [29]:
class RandomForest:
    def __init__(self, n_estimators=100, max_depth=None, max_features='sqrt'):
        self.n_estimators = n_estimators
        self.max_depth = max_depth
        self.max_features = max_features
        self.trees = []
        self.bootstraps = [] 
        self.oob_indices = [] 

    def _feature_count(self, n_features):
        if self.max_features == 'sqrt':
            return int(np.sqrt(n_features))
        elif self.max_features == 'log2':
            return int(np.log2(n_features))
        elif isinstance(self.max_features, int):
            return self.max_features
        else:
            return n_features

    def fit(self, X, y):
        self.trees = []
        self.bootstraps = []
        self.oob_indices = []

        n_samples, n_features = X.shape
        n_feats = self._feature_count(n_features)

        for _ in range(self.n_estimators):
            indices = np.random.choice(n_samples, size=n_samples, replace=True)
            oob = list(set(range(n_samples)) - set(indices))

            tree = DecisionTree(max_depth=self.max_depth, max_features=n_feats)
            tree.fit(X[indices], y[indices])

            self.trees.append(tree)
            self.bootstraps.append(indices)
            self.oob_indices.append(oob)

    def predict(self, X):
        preds = np.array([tree.predict(X) for tree in self.trees])
        maj_votes = [Counter(preds[:, i]).most_common(1)[0][0] for i in range(X.shape[0])]
        return np.array(maj_votes)

    def oob_score(self, X, y):
        n_samples = X.shape[0]
        oob_votes = [Counter() for _ in range(n_samples)]

        for tree, oob_idx in zip(self.trees, self.oob_indices):
            if not oob_idx:
                continue
            preds = tree.predict(X[oob_idx])
            for i, idx in enumerate(oob_idx):
                oob_votes[idx][preds[i]] += 1

        final_preds = []
        final_y = []
        for i, counter in enumerate(oob_votes):
            if counter:
                final_preds.append(counter.most_common(1)[0][0])
                final_y.append(y[i])

        correct = np.sum(np.array(final_preds) == np.array(final_y))
        return correct / len(final_y) if final_y else None

n_runs = 100

start_custom = time.time()
for _ in range(n_runs):
    rf = RandomForest(n_estimators=10)
    rf.fit(X_classification_train, y_classification_train)
    rf.predict(X_classification_test)
end_custom = time.time() - start_custom
print(f"Czas 100x RandomForest (custom): {end_custom:.2f} s")

start_sklearn = time.time()
for _ in range(n_runs):
    clf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=10, random_state=my_index)
    clf.fit(X_classification_train, y_classification_train)
    clf.predict(X_classification_test)
end_sklearn = time.time() - start_sklearn
print(f"Czas 100x RandomForestClassifier (sklearn): {end_sklearn:.2f} s")

Imputacja brakujących wartości¶

In [41]:
missing_values_before = X.isnull().sum()
missing_values_before = missing_values_before[missing_values_before > 0]

for col in categorical_columns:
    mode_value = X[col].mode()[0]
    X[col].fillna(mode_value, inplace=True)

for col in numerical_columns:
    median_value = X[col].median()
    X[col].fillna(median_value, inplace=True)

missing_values_after = X.isnull().sum()

comparison_table = pd.DataFrame({
    'Column': missing_values_before.index,
    'Missing Before': missing_values_before.values,
    'Missing After': missing_values_after[missing_values_before.index].values
})

Zadanie na 5¶

Analiza wpływu wielkości lasu na jego skuteczność

Własna implementacja¶

In [52]:
max_population = range(1, 11, 2)

accuracies = []
sensitivities = []
specificities = []
speed = []

for population in max_population:
    times = []
    accs = []
    sens = []
    spec = []
    for _ in range(5):
        clf = RandomForest(n_estimators=population)
        clf.fit(X_neo_train.to_numpy(), y_neo_train.to_numpy())
        start_time = time.time()
        y_pred = clf.predict(X_neo_test.to_numpy())
        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        accuracy, sensitivity, specificity = calculate_metrics(y_neo_test, y_pred)
        accs.append(accuracy)
        sens.append(sensitivity)
        spec.append(specificity)
        times.append(elapsed)
    accuracies.append(np.mean(accs))
    sensitivities.append(np.mean(sens))
    specificities.append(np.mean(spec))
    speed.append(np.mean(times))

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 10))

for i, (vals, label, color) in enumerate(zip(
    [accuracies, sensitivities, specificities, speed],
    ['Accuracy', 'Sensitivity', 'Specificity', 'Czas [s]'],
    ['b', 'orange', 'green', 'red'])):
    plt.subplot(2, 2, i+1)
    plt.plot(max_population, vals, marker='o', color=color)
    plt.xlabel('Populacja')
    plt.ylabel(label)
    plt.title(f'{label} vs Populacja')
    plt.grid(True)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
